name: Miami
living: the home run sculpture's neon rainbow arcs chase with light, and it lights up fully on a home run
the pixel dolphins and flamingos on the sculpture bob gently, as if animatronic
palm fronds sway slowly in the warm sea breeze
the video board's pixel sunset shimmers over the water, its palm silhouettes swaying
pastel art-deco neon signs buzz on as the sun goes down, with a rare soft flicker
coral clouds drift slowly across the synthwave sky (sky layer drift)
a pelican or a small flock of birds glides across the pink sky now and then
tower windows twinkle on as dusk falls; light-tower lamps glow and breathe
crowd shimmer, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
